figurative_meaning_en: To gain knowledge or to make someone aware/enlightened
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই অভিজ্ঞতা আমার চোখ খুলে দিয়েছে।
সে তার ভুল বুঝতে পেরে চোখ খুলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This experience has opened my eyes.
He opened his eyes to his mistake.
note: The idiom metaphorically refers to gaining insight, akin to removing blindness.
